newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia bank Vipa posts 1996 net fall.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia bank Vipa posts 1996 net fall.

text.p: Slovenian bank Vipa said on Friday 1996 net profit fell to 265.9 million tolars ($1.7 million) from 316.4 million in 1995.
Vipa said it would pay an unchanged dividend for 1996 of 1,600 tolars per share, which is expected to be approved by shareholders next week.
The bank said net profit was down due to higher taxes, while 1996 pre-tax profit firmed to 349.9 million tolars from 342.8 million.
Vipa's balance sheet assets rose to 35.9 billion tolars from 28.1 billion on an increase of a number of clients.
Vipa is listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse and was last traded on May 6 when its shares firmed 2.97 percent to 45,000 tolars. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
